skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the impact of macro and micro marketing environments on organizations and related customers.
Apply marketing knowledge to specific products, businesses, markets, and industries.
Integrate knowledge and skills to analyze phenomena and identify marketing issues.
Develop critical thinking skills to form personal opinions.
Write reports with clear structure, logical reasoning, and proper formatting.
Collect secondary information from the internet for research purposes.
Understand social context, professional ethics, and social responsibility.
Demonstrate independent work skills and take responsibility for personal work.
